title: You are preparing tooth #30 for a full-coverage restoration using a diamond shoulder burr. You had anesthetized the area with a mandibular block injection. He did not seem too phased by the injury. You are worried that you may have induced a cosmetic defect. You called the patient that evening to check on how he was feeling. He reported no bleeding since he left the dental clinic and that the area was slightly sensitive, but not painful. Two weeks later the patient presents for the crown insertion. You are happily surprised to see that the lip appears totally normal with no signs that it was ever injured.
